principle: Green automation is necessary but not sufficient for production launch. External, human-review and cutover gates remain pending until evidence is recorded; main/DNS/payment actions require explicit authorization.

gates.evidence: The integration workflow contains lint, typecheck, unit coverage, production build, bundle budgets, smoke checks and 74 Playwright browser acceptance checks. CI #632 passed the complete verify job on integration SHA 63dcc3ae6384c7a388f6f0f241bf059ddf6cd6db; every later launch candidate must independently pass the same current workflow.

Railway preview deployment dae7e669-6640-4b8b-a8dc-c7ce4f48c741 succeeded on exact integration SHA 63dcc3ae6384c7a388f6f0f241bf059ddf6cd6db. Each later launch candidate still requires an exact-SHA successful deployment before release approval.
Public donation/appeal flows state India-only domestic contribution boundaries; Amaana is not represented as FCRA-registered.

CI #632 staging-runtime-acceptance verified that Railway was serving exact SHA 63dcc3ae6384c7a388f6f0f241bf059ddf6cd6db, then passed deployed version, live health, database/environment readiness, staging noindex, representative public routes, domestic-only appeals framing, and assistance privacy/header checks. Synthetic checkout fixture was not required; mocked browser CI remains the mandatory donation-journey gate.

Automated responsive/axe checks are durable, but final human rendered review at representative desktop/tablet/mobile widths, 200% zoom, keyboard-only operation, reduced motion and key fixed-control states remains required.
Final public copy/CTA/terminology/amount-format consistency plus production canonical, schema, robots/indexing and social-share preview review remains required before cutover.

docs/public-media-review-register.json intentionally leaves legacy directly addressable media pending human privacy/consent/provenance review. npm run media:review-readiness is the fail-closed launch check.

Current Railway service variable names do not include the dedicated PUBLIC_MEDIA_S3_BUCKET and PUBLIC_MEDIA_BASE_URL configuration required for admin public-media uploads/delivery. src/lib/storage.ts intentionally requires a public bucket separate from the private assistance bucket. Bundled reviewed files are unaffected.
12A/12AB status still requires CA confirmation. The known 80G record is provisional Form 10AC dated 2026-01-26 for AY 2026-27 through 2028-29 and must not be presented as permanent approval.
Razorpay integration exists, but live KYC/account readiness has not been independently certified in this implementation workflow.
Browser donation journeys are mocked and green. No real charge will be initiated without explicit authorization.
Refund, receipt/acknowledgement and reconciliation operations still require controlled operational verification.
A recoverable Neon/PostgreSQL backup or snapshot must be confirmed immediately before rehearsal/cutover; no backup action is inferred from application CI.
Rollback procedure must be rehearsed against staging/preview and record the known-good SHA/deployment before production cutover.
Cloudflare/DNS production cutover and rollback values must be recorded and explicitly approved before change.
Staging remains noindex. Production indexing must only be enabled as part of the approved cutover after final SEO/privacy review.
Merging to main and production cutover remain explicitly user-gated actions.
